description: End-to-end checkout workflow for purchasing and provisioning SASE connectivity services (sites, users, policies, and add-ons).

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer (organization or tenant).

cart_id.description: Unique identifier for a SASE service shopping cart.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for a submitted SASE service order.

quote_id.description: Unique identifier for a pricing quote.

site_id.description: Identifier for a branch/edge site where SASE will be deployed.

user_profile_id.description: Identifier for a remote user or user group profile.

sase_plan_id.description: Identifier for a SASE product plan or SKU.

billing_profile_id.description: Identifier for a customer's billing profile or account.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: search_sase_offers
functions.description: Search for available SASE service offers, plans, and bundles for a given customer and deployment profile.

customer_id.description: Customer for which offers are being searched.

deployment_profile.description: High-level deployment requirements used to filter offers.

regions.description: Target geographic regions for the service.

performance_tier.description: Desired performance tier for backbone and PoP access.

max_price_per_user.description: Maximum acceptable price per user per month in account currency.

max_price_per_site.description: Maximum acceptable price per site per month in account currency.

functions.returns: Paginated list of recommended SASE plans, bundles, and add-ons with high-level pricing.

functions.name: create_sase_cart
functions.description: Create a new SASE service cart and optionally seed it with initial plan selections.

initial_items.description: Optional initial SASE plan and quantity selections.

sase_plan_id.description: Identifier of the SASE plan to add.

item_type.description: Indicates whether this is a site-based, user-based, or add-on SKU.

config.description: Optional configuration attributes that affect pricing.

bandwidth_mbps.description: Committed bandwidth per site for site bundles.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for the cart (e.g., external reference IDs).

functions.returns: New cart ID, current cart contents, and initial pricing summary.

functions.name: add_or_update_cart_items
functions.description: Add new items to a SASE cart or update quantities/configuration of existing items.

operations.description: List of add/update/remove operations on cart items.

cart_item_id.description: Identifier of the existing cart item (required for update/remove).

item.description: Definition of the item being added or updated.

recalculate_immediately.description: If true, recalculates pricing after modifications.

functions.returns: Updated cart contents, including item IDs, and latest pricing summary.

functions.name: configure_cart_sites_and_users
functions.description: Attach detailed site and user topology to an existing SASE cart for accurate pricing and feasibility validation.

cart_id.description: Cart to enrich with topology configuration.

sites.description: List of branch/edge sites to be covered under site-based plans.

site_id.description: Existing site identifier, if known; can be omitted for new sites.

policy_profile.description: High-level policy intent applied to the site.

user_profiles.description: Remote user or user group profiles for user-based bundles.

count.description: Number of users represented by this profile.

functions.returns: Cart topology configuration with normalized site_ids and user_profile_ids and any validation warnings.

functions.name: validate_and_quote_cart
functions.description: Validate technical feasibility and generate a commercial quote for the current cart configuration.

validation_options.description: Controls the strictness and scope of validations.

pricing_options.description: Pricing and discount context for the quote.

auto_resolve_minor_issues.description: Automatically suggest and apply non-breaking adjustments (e.g., rounding bandwidth).

functions.returns: Quote ID, detailed pricing breakdown, list of validation issues/errors, and any auto-adjustments applied.

functions.name: accept_quote_and_create_order
functions.description: Accept a generated quote and create a SASE service order ready for payment.

quote_id.description: Identifier of the quote being accepted.

billing_profile_id.description: Billing profile to be used for invoicing and taxation.

order_contact.description: Primary commercial/technical contact for the order.

accept_terms.description: Indicates that the customer has accepted the terms and conditions associated with the quote.

functions.returns: Order ID, initial order status, and summary of items and charges carried over from the quote.

functions.name: process_sase_order_payment
functions.description: Process payment or credit approval for a SASE order.

card_token.description: Tokenized card reference when paying by credit card.

marketplace_reference.description: Third-party marketplace transaction reference, if applicable.

amount_override.description: Optional override amount when partial payment is allowed (e.g., deposit).

capture_immediately.description: Whether to capture payment immediately (vs authorize only).

functions.returns: Payment transaction ID, payment status, and updated order financial status.

functions.name: get_sase_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, milestones, and any fulfillment blockers for a SASE order.

include.description: Optional additional related entities to include.

functions.returns: Order status, provisioning progress, blocking issues (if any), and optional details on items, payments, and history.

functions.name: start_sase_provisioning
functions.description: Initiate or re-initiate automated provisioning workflows for an eligible SASE order.

order_id.description: Order whose provisioning should be started.

sites.description: Specific site_ids to provision; if omitted, all sites are targeted.

user_profiles.description: Specific user_profile_ids to provision; if omitted, all profiles are targeted.

include_policies.description: Whether to apply associated security policies as part of provisioning.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate provisioning and return an impact report.

functions.returns: Provisioning job ID, job status (queued/running/dry_run), and summary of affected sites and user profiles.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_provisioning
functions.description: Retry failed provisioning tasks or perform a partial rollback for a SASE order.

order_id.description: Order whose provisioning tasks are being retried or rolled back.

task_scope.description: Optional fine-grained task scope when retrying specific parts.

rollback_strategy.description: Determines the depth of rollback when action is rollback_partial.

reason.description: Human readable description of the issue leading to retry/rollback.

functions.returns: Recovery job ID, list of targeted tasks/resources, and updated provisioning state summary.

functions.name: modify_sase_order_before_activation
functions.description: Modify an order in pre-activation state (e.g., change bandwidth, add sites/users, or adjust term), and recalculate pricing deltas.

modifications.description: Requested changes to the SASE order.

line_item_updates.description: Quantity or configuration updates on existing line items.

additions.description: New SASE items to add to the order.

removals.description: Existing line items to remove entirely.

term_change.description: Change the contract term for the entire order, if allowed.

simulate_only.description: If true, returns impact and any required charges/credits without applying the change.

functions.returns: Summary of modifications, pricing impact (MRC/NRC deltas), required approvals, and whether changes were applied or simulated.

functions.name: cancel_sase_order
functions.description: Cancel a SASE order at various stages (pre-activation, in-provisioning, or post-activation) with appropriate consequences.

cancellation_stage.description: Indicates when the cancellation is being requested; used to determine fees and deprovisioning scope.

refund_preference.description: Preferred refund or credit option, subject to policy.

deprovisioning_options.description: Controls how services are deprovisioned for post-activation cancellations.

retain_policies_only.description: If true, keeps policies and config templates but tears down tunnels and access.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, effective date, deprovisioning plan, and refund/credit details if applicable.

functions.name: list_customer_sase_orders
functions.description: List and filter SASE orders for a given customer for tracking and reporting purposes.
functions.returns: Paginated list of SASE orders for the customer with high-level financials and statuses.

functions.name: sase_checkout_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sase checkout entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sase_checkout_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sase checkout entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sase_checkout_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sase checkout entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sase_checkout_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sase checkout entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sase_checkout_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sase checkout entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sase_checkout_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sase checkout events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sase_checkout_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sase checkout notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sase_checkout_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sase checkout entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sase_checkout_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sase checkout on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sase_checkout_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sase checkout operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sase_checkout_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sase checkout change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sase_checkout_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sase checkout approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sase_checkout_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sase checkout entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sase_checkout_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sase checkout entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sase_checkout_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sase checkout entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sase_checkout_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sase checkout entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sase_checkout_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sase checkout activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sase_checkout_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sase checkout view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sase_checkout_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sase checkout entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sase_checkout_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sase checkout payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sase_checkout_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sase checkout entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sase_checkout_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sase checkout entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
